答案:
📌 參考答案
D. 在較高溫度時，基質分子有較多動能。
D. The substrate molecules have more kinetic energy at higher temperatures.

📌 詳細解釋
在較高溫度下，受質（基質）分子擁有較多動能。
At a higher temperature, substrate molecules possess more kinetic energy.
這增加了它們與酶分子互相撞擊及形成酶受質複合物的機會，從而提升初始反應速率。
This increases the chance that enzymes and substrates will collide with each other forming enzyme-substrate complexes, thereby increasing the initial reaction rate.
選項 A 錯誤，催化劑在高溫下變性會導致反應速率下降，無法解釋速率為何較高。
Option A is incorrect; catalase denatures at high temperatures which would decrease the reaction rate and cannot explain the higher initial rate.
選項 B 錯誤，氧氣在較高溫度時溶解度較低，但若溶解度較高反而會令測量到的釋出量減少。
Option B is incorrect; oxygen is more soluble at higher temperatures, which would actually decrease the amount of oxygen given out as it dissolves in the solution.
選項 C 錯誤，溫度上升會改變蛋白質構象，反而減少酶的活性部位數量。
Option C is incorrect; an increase in temperature changes the conformation of proteins, which actually decreases the number of active sites on an enzyme.

📌 考試提醒
溫度上升會增加分子的動能及有效碰撞頻率，從而加快酶促反應速率。
An increase in temperature raises the kinetic energy of molecules and their effective collision frequency, thereby speeding up the enzyme-catalyzed reaction.
常見錯誤：學生常誤以為溫度改變會增加酶分子活性部位的數量，或未能分辨初始速率與最終生成物總量的分別。
Common trap: Students often mistakenly think that a temperature change increases the number of active sites on enzyme molecules, or fail to distinguish between the initial rate and the total amount of product formed.

📌 參考答案
B. 在這兩個溫度，5分鐘內所釋出的氧分量相同。
B. The amount of oxygen released in 5 minutes is the same at both temperatures.

📌 詳細解釋
由圖表可見，兩條曲線最終到達同一水平，代表釋出的氧氣總量相同。
From the graph, both curves reach the same level, representing the same total amount of oxygen released.
選項 A 錯誤，釋出氧的速率為圖表的斜率，該斜率在一開始時為最大。
Option A is incorrect; the rate of oxygen release is the slope of the graph, which is greatest at the beginning.
選項 C 錯誤，30°C 時需 5 分鐘分解全部過氧化氫，而 40°C 時只需 1.5 分鐘，因此分解所需時間並不相同。
Option C is incorrect; the time for 30°C to decompose all hydrogen peroxide is 5 minutes while that for 40°C is only 1.5 minutes, so the time needed is not the same.
選項 D 錯誤，實驗完結時，所有酶受質複合物都會分解，酶的活性部位不會被佔據。
Option D is incorrect; at the end of the experiment, all substrate-enzyme complexes dissociate, so no active sites of enzymes are occupied.

📌 考試提醒
酶促反應的最終產物總量僅取決於基質的初始總量，與溫度等反應條件無關。
The total amount of product in an enzyme-catalyzed reaction depends solely on the initial amount of substrates, independent of reaction conditions such as temperature.
常見錯誤：學生常誤以為較高溫度會產生較多產物，而忽略了產物總量受限於基質的總量。
Common trap: Students often mistakenly believe that a higher temperature yields more products, ignoring that the total product amount is limited by the total amount of substrates.

📌 參考答案
C. [曲線迅速平坦且極低]
C. [Curve flattens quickly at a very low level]

📌 詳細解釋
在 90°C 的極端高溫下，大部分的過氧化氫酶都會因過熱而變性，不能再催化產生氧。
At 90°C, most of the catalase enzymes are denatured by heat and can no longer function to produce oxygen.
因此在實驗期間只有極少量的氧氣產生，曲線會維持在極低水平。
Therefore, only a very little amount of oxygen can be produced throughout the experiment, keeping the curve at a very low level.
選項 A、B 及 D 的圖表皆顯示 90°C 時仍能產生大量氧氣，這不符合酶變性後完全喪失催化能力的原理。
The graphs in Options A, B, and D all show that a large amount of oxygen is still produced at 90°C, which contradicts the principle that enzymes completely lose catalytic ability after denaturation.

📌 考試提醒
極端高溫會破壞維持酶三維結構的化學鍵，引致不可逆轉的變性，使活性部位變形。
Extreme high temperatures break the chemical bonds maintaining the three-dimensional structure of enzymes, causing irreversible denaturation where the active site changes shape.
常見錯誤：學生未能掌握酶在極高溫下會「迅速變性」的特點，誤以為高溫只會減慢反應但最終仍能完成反應。
Common trap: Students fail to grasp that enzymes "rapidly denature" at extreme high temperatures, mistakenly assuming high temperatures only slow down the reaction but still allow it to go to completion.

📌 參考答案
B. 他們捕獵北極區的動物作為食物。
B. They hunt animals in the Arctic region for food.

📌 詳細解釋
由於北極的氣候極端，並不適宜耕種，因此愛斯基摩人的主要食糧是極區內的動物。
Due to the extreme climate of the Arctic regions, crop growing is impossible, so the main source of food of Eskimos is polar animals.
因為這些動物體內含有大量脂肪，所以愛斯基摩人的膳食自然含有大量脂肪。
Because these animals usually contain plenty of fat, the Eskimos' diet is naturally rich in fat.
選項 A 及 C 錯誤，脂肪是良好的隔熱層及有較高能量值是這種現象的生態好處，並非他們膳食含高脂肪的直接成因。
Options A and C are incorrect; fat being a good heat insulator and having a higher energy value are the ecological benefits of the phenomenon, rather than the direct causes of their high-fat diet.
選項 D 錯誤，人類的消化道並沒有特別為消化極端高脂肪膳食而作出演化改變。
Option D is incorrect; the human digestive tract has not undergone evolutionary changes specifically for digesting extremely high-fat diets.

📌 考試提醒
人類膳食成分的特徵往往受限於其棲息地的生態環境及可獲得的食物來源。
The characteristics of a human diet are often limited by the ecological environment of their habitat and the available food sources.
常見錯誤：學生容易將膳食現象的「生態適應好處」與「客觀環境成因」混淆。
Common trap: Students easily confuse the "ecological adaptation benefits" of a dietary phenomenon with its "objective environmental causes."

📌 參考答案
B. 有助除去吸入空氣中的塵埃。
B. It helps to remove dust in the inhaled air.

📌 詳細解釋
鼻腔內的黏液由黏液分泌細胞製造，能有效黏住吸入空氣中的塵埃和細菌。
The mucus in the nasal cavity is produced by mucus-secreting cells to effectively trap dust and germs in the inhaled air.
選項 A 錯誤，吸入的空氣是由呼吸道的微血管暖化的，而非該層薄黏液。
Option A is incorrect; the inhaled air is warmed up by the blood capillaries along the airway, not by the thin layer of mucus.
選項 C 錯誤，空氣流動的阻力相對於液體為小，因此呼吸道並不需要潤滑。
Option C is incorrect; the resistance of air flow is relatively lower than liquid, so the airway does not need to be lubricated.
選項 D 錯誤，氣體交換只在具有極薄表面的肺泡發生，絕對不會在鼻腔內發生。
Option D is incorrect; gas exchange occurs only at the extremely thin surface of the alveoli and never in the nasal cavity.

📌 考試提醒
鼻腔內黏液負責黏附塵埃及細菌，而纖毛的擺動則負責將黏液向上推往喉頭吞嚥。
The mucus in the nasal cavity traps dust and bacteria, while the beating action of cilia moves the mucus up the pharynx to be swallowed.
常見錯誤：學生常誤以為黏液同時負責暖化空氣，或以為鼻腔具有氣體交換功能。
Common trap: Students often mistakenly assume that mucus is also responsible for warming the air, or that the nasal cavity has a gas exchange function.

📌 參考答案
A. 麥皮蟲用去的氧分量。
A. The amount of oxygen used up by the mealworms.

📌 詳細解釋
在實驗裝置中，麥皮蟲不停地進行呼吸，吸入氧氣並呼出等量的二氧化碳。
In the experimental set-up, the mealworms carried out respiration continuously, taking in oxygen and breathing out the same amount of carbon dioxide.
由於呼出的二氧化碳被底部的鹼石灰完全吸收，裝置內的氣壓下降，因此該滴液體向內移動是由於用去的氧分量。
Because the carbon dioxide produced is completely absorbed by the soda lime at the bottom, the air pressure inside the set-up decreases, so the inward movement of the liquid drop is due to the intake of oxygen.
選項 B 錯誤，二氧化碳已被吸收，液體移動顯示的是氣體總量的減少，而非其產生量。
Option B is incorrect; carbon dioxide has been absorbed, and the movement indicates a decrease in the total amount of gas, not its production amount.
選項 C 錯誤，釋出的熱能雖會令空氣膨脹將液體向外推，但在本實驗的規模中其效應可忽略不計。
Option C is incorrect; heat produced would expand the air and push the drop outwards, but the heat effect is negligible in the scale of this experiment.

📌 考試提醒
在呼吸計（respirometer）裝置中，鹼石灰或氫氧化鉀的作用是吸收二氧化碳，使體積變化單純反映氧氣的消耗。
In a respirometer set-up, the function of soda lime or potassium hydroxide is to absorb carbon dioxide, making the volume change strictly reflect oxygen consumption.
常見錯誤：學生常忘記鹼石灰的作用，誤以為液滴移動代表氧氣消耗與二氧化碳生成的淨差額。
Common trap: Students often forget the function of soda lime, mistakenly thinking the drop movement represents the net difference between oxygen consumed and carbon dioxide produced.

📌 參考答案
B. 把麥皮蟲從裝置中移走
B. Remove the mealworms from the set-up

📌 詳細解釋
科學探究中的對照裝置應除去探究的對象（即麥皮蟲），以證明實驗結果確實由該對象引起。
The control set-up in a scientific investigation should remove the factor being studied (i.e., the mealworms) to prove that the experimental results are indeed caused by that object.
這樣可以計算出大氣氣壓改變及其他環境因素對液滴位置的影響，使估量出的呼吸速率更加準確。
This accounts for the changes in the liquid position due to atmospheric pressure changes and other environmental factors, yielding a more accurate respiration rate.
選項 A 錯誤，以蒸餾水取代鹼石灰會改變裝置吸收氣體的條件，失去對照原有設定的意義。
Option A is incorrect; replacing soda lime with distilled water would change the gas absorption conditions of the set-up, losing the meaning of controlling the original settings.
選項 C 及 D 錯誤，改變溫度或光暗環境會引入額外的獨立變數，違反公平測試原則。
Options C and D are incorrect; changing the temperature or light conditions would introduce additional independent variables, violating the principle of a fair test.

📌 考試提醒
對照實驗（Control experiment）必須只改變一個獨立變項，通常是移除活體生物或將其換成等體積的死物（如玻璃珠）。
A control experiment must only change one independent variable, usually by removing the living organism or replacing it with an equal volume of dead matter (like glass beads).
常見錯誤：學生誤以為對照裝置需要改變化學試劑或物理環境條件，而不是針對實驗對象本身。
Common trap: Students mistakenly think that a control set-up requires changing chemical reagents or physical environmental conditions, rather than targeting the experimental subject itself.

📌 參考答案
D. 木材的供應持續。
D. The supply of wood is continuous.

📌 詳細解釋
可再生資源是指在消耗後，可以依賴自然過程重新產生的自然資源。
Renewable resources are natural resources that can regenerate through natural processes after consumption.
樹木可不停地栽種，當人類砍伐的速率低於大自然可再生樹木的速率時，木材的供應就可維持持續。
Trees can be planted continuously; provided the rate of deforestation is below the rate nature can regrow trees, the supply of timber will be continuous.
選項 A 及 B 錯誤，可再用或可再循環與資源本身是否為「可再生」的生態學定義無關。
Options A and B are incorrect; being reusable or recyclable is unrelated to the ecological definition of whether the resource itself is "renewable."
選項 C 錯誤，供應充足只反映當下的存量，並不代表它消耗後能自我再生。
Option C is incorrect; an abundant supply only reflects the current stock and does not mean it can regenerate itself after consumption.

📌 考試提醒
可再生資源的關鍵定義在於「自然再生速率等於或大於人類消耗速率」，從而達致可持續供應。
The key definition of renewable resources is that the "natural regeneration rate is equal to or greater than the human consumption rate," thereby achieving a sustainable supply.
常見錯誤：學生常將「可再生（Renewable）」與「可回收利用（Recyclable）」兩個環保概念混淆。
Common trap: Students often confuse the two environmental concepts of "Renewable" and "Recyclable".

📌 參考答案
C. 只有(1)和(2)
C. (1) and (2) only

📌 詳細解釋
(1) 正確：木質導管由空心的死細胞首尾相連接駁而成，沒有細胞質和細胞核，細胞間沒有端壁，能極大減小運輸水分的阻力。
(1) is correct: Xylem vessels have a hollow cell structure with no cell contents or end-plates between cells to greatly reduce the resistance of water transport.
(2) 正確：葉肉細胞的細胞壁薄以加快物質擴散，並含有大量葉綠體以作為光合作用的主要場所。
(2) is correct: Mesophyll cells have thin cell walls for rapid diffusion of substances and contain abundant chloroplasts as the main site for photosynthesis.
(3) 錯誤：根部表皮細胞的主要功能是從泥土中吸收水分及礦物質，因此絕不擁有不滲水的角質層。
(3) is incorrect: The main function of root epidermal cells is the absorption of water and minerals from the soil, so they absolutely do not possess an impermeable cuticle.

📌 考試提醒
根部表皮細胞缺乏角質層，並具有根毛以增加表面積；莖和葉的表皮細胞則有角質層以防止水分流失。
Root epidermal cells lack a cuticle and have root hairs to increase surface area; epidermal cells of stems and leaves have a cuticle to prevent water loss.
常見錯誤：學生常誤以為所有植物最外層的表皮細胞都一律覆蓋著角質層作保護。
Common trap: Students often mistakenly assume that all outermost epidermal cells of a plant are uniformly covered with a cuticle for protection.

📌 參考答案
A. 氫：碳水化合物，氧：氧氣
A. Hydrogen: Carbohydrate, Oxygen: Oxygen gas

📌 詳細解釋
在光合作用的光反應中，水分子被光能分解為氫原子和氧原子，氧原子互相結合產生氧氣作為副產物排出。
In the light reaction of photosynthesis, water molecules are split into hydrogen and oxygen atoms by light energy, and oxygen atoms combine to produce oxygen gas as a by-product.
同時，光解產生的氫原子會在隨後的暗反應中，用於將二氧化碳還原成碳水化合物。
Meanwhile, the hydrogen atoms produced by photolysis are used in the subsequent dark reaction to reduce carbon dioxide into carbohydrates.
選項 B 錯誤，水分子中的氧原子最終會釋放成氧氣，絕對不會成為碳水化合物的組成部分。
Option B is incorrect; the oxygen atoms from water molecules are eventually released as oxygen gas and never become part of the carbohydrates.
選項 C 及 D 錯誤，光合作用的生化過程中絕不會釋出游離的氫氣。
Options C and D are incorrect; the biochemical process of photosynthesis never releases free hydrogen gas.

📌 考試提醒
水的光解（光反應）負責產生氧氣副產物；二氧化碳的固碳作用（暗反應）負責提供碳和氧原子以產生碳水化合物。
The photolysis of water (light reaction) is responsible for producing the oxygen by-product; the carbon fixation of carbon dioxide (dark reaction) is responsible for providing carbon and oxygen atoms to produce carbohydrates.
常見錯誤：學生常誤以為水分子直接將氫和氧原封不動地轉移到碳水化合物中，忽略了氧氣是來自水的裂解。
Common trap: Students often mistakenly think that water molecules transfer both hydrogen and oxygen directly into carbohydrates, ignoring that oxygen gas comes from the splitting of water.

📌 參考答案
D. 轉化為尿素和碳水化合物。
D. Converted to urea and carbohydrate.

📌 詳細解釋
人體無法在體內貯存過量的氨基酸，過量的氨基酸必須在肝臟中進行脫氨作用。
The human body cannot store excess amino acids, which must undergo deamination in the liver.
氨基酸的氨基會被轉化為尿素排出，而餘下的碳骨架（羧基和側鏈）則會轉化為碳水化合物作呼吸之用。
The amino group of amino acids will be converted into urea for excretion, and the remaining carbon skeleton (carboxyl group and side chain) will be converted into carbohydrates for respiration.
選項 A 錯誤，膽汁是由分解衰老紅血細胞產生的膽色素及碳酸氫鹽組成。
Option A is incorrect; bile is formed by bile pigments from the breakdown of old red blood cells and hydrogencarbonate.
選項 B 錯誤，雖然適量氨基酸可用來形成新細胞，但過剩的部分必然會被排泄而非強行轉化為細胞。
Option B is incorrect; although appropriate amounts of amino acids can be used to form new cells, the excess portion will inevitably be excreted rather than forcibly converted into cells.
選項 C 錯誤，人體沒有任何機制以蛋白質形式大量貯存過剩的氨基酸。
Option C is incorrect; the human body has no mechanism to store excess amino acids in large amounts as proteins.

📌 考試提醒
肝臟是處理過量氨基酸（脫氨作用）的唯一器官，過程產生含氮廢物（尿素）及可用的能量物質（碳水化合物/脂質）。
The liver is the only organ that processes excess amino acids (deamination), producing nitrogenous waste (urea) and usable energy substances (carbohydrates/lipids).
常見錯誤：學生常誤以為蛋白質像脂肪或糖原一樣，可以隨意大量儲存在人體內備用。
Common trap: Students often mistakenly think that proteins, like fats or glycogen, can be casually stored in large amounts in the human body for future use.

📌 參考答案
C. 不正確。因為即使瑪莉是雜合的，她的兩名孩子均可屬血型A。
C. Incorrect. Because even if Mary is heterozygous, both her children can be of blood group A.

📌 詳細解釋
瑪莉的丈夫是 O 型（基因型 aa），因此兩名屬 A 型的孩子必定從瑪莉那裡遺傳了一個顯性 A 等位基因。
Mary's husband is blood group O (genotype aa), so both children with blood group A must have inherited a dominant A allele from Mary.
然而，每一次遺傳的概率都是獨立的；若瑪莉是雜合子（Aa），她每次生育仍有 1/2 機會誕下 A 型孩子。
However, the probability of each inheritance is independent; if Mary is heterozygous (Aa), she still has a 1/2 chance of giving birth to an A-group child each time.
因此，兩名孩子均屬 A 型是完全符合概率可能的，瑪莉並不一定是純合子（AA）。
Therefore, it is entirely possible probabilistically for both children to be blood group A, meaning Mary is not necessarily homozygous (AA).
選項 A 及 B 錯誤，完全忽略了每次受精事件的獨立性，錯誤推斷雜合子必定會生出表現型不同的下一代。
Options A and B are incorrect; they completely ignore the independence of each fertilization event, falsely concluding that a heterozygote must produce offspring with different phenotypes.

📌 考試提醒
在遺傳學中，每一次受精事件都是獨立的隨機事件，過往的生育結果不會影響下一次的基因組合理論概率。
In genetics, every fertilization event is an independent random event; past reproductive results do not affect the theoretical probability of the next genetic combination.
常見錯誤：學生常誤以為若父母是雜合子，其子代的實際表現型數量比例就必須完美符合 3:1 或 1:1 的理論比例。
Common trap: Students often mistakenly assume that if parents are heterozygous, the actual phenotypic numerical ratio of their offspring must perfectly match the theoretical ratio of 3:1 or 1:1.

📌 參考答案
C. 它有助分解脂肪成為微滴。
C. It helps to break down fat into droplets.

📌 詳細解釋
膽汁含有膽鹽，能透過物理方式將大油滴乳化為小油滴，這過程稱為乳化作用。
Bile contains bile salts that emulsify large oil drops into little droplets through a physical process known as emulsification.
乳化作用大幅增加了脂質的表面積，有利胰液和腸液中的脂肪酶更快速地發揮化學消化作用。
Emulsification significantly increases the surface area of lipids, facilitating pancreatic and intestinal lipase to exert their chemical digestion more rapidly.
選項 A 錯誤，膽汁是由肝臟製造的，膽囊僅負責暫時貯存及濃縮膽汁。
Option A is incorrect; bile is produced by the liver, and the gall bladder is only responsible for temporarily storing and concentrating bile.
選項 B 錯誤，膽汁絕對不含任何消化酶，其主要成分是碳酸氫鈉和膽鹽/膽色素。
Option B is incorrect; bile absolutely does not contain any digestive enzymes; its main components are sodium hydrogencarbonate and bile salts/pigments.

選項 A、C 及 D 錯誤，因為(1)與(3)兩者皆因生長素均勻分佈而不會出現任何彎曲生長。
Options A, C, and D are incorrect because both (1) and (3) experience an even distribution of auxin and will not exhibit any bending growth.

📌 考試提醒
向光彎曲的根本原因是「生長素在兩側分佈不均」。除了單向光，人為不對稱地放置含生長素的瓊脂亦能製造彎曲。
The fundamental cause of phototropic bending is "uneven auxin distribution on both sides". Besides unilateral light, artificially placing auxin-containing agar asymmetrically can also induce bending.
常見錯誤：學生死記硬背有光才有彎曲，忽略了瓊脂塊能直接繞過光學受體在黑暗中強行引發不對稱生長。
Common trap: Students blindly memorize that light is strictly required for bending, ignoring that agar blocks can directly bypass optical receptors to forcefully induce asymmetric growth in the dark.

📌 參考答案
C. 缺氧呼吸提供額外的能量以作肌肉收縮之用。
C. Anaerobic respiration provides extra energy for muscle contraction.

📌 詳細解釋
運動時骨骼肌的能量需求劇增，當血液供應的氧氣不足以讓需氧呼吸滿足所有能量需求時，肌肉便會額外進行缺氧呼吸。
Energy demand in skeletal muscles surges during exercise; when the oxygen supplied by blood is insufficient for aerobic respiration to meet all energy demands, muscles will additionally carry out anaerobic respiration.
這短暫但快速的過程能為肌肉收縮提供不可或缺的額外 ATP。
This short but rapid process provides indispensable extra ATP for muscle contraction.
選項 A 錯誤，即使缺氧，肌肉細胞仍會用盡所有的氧氣持續進行需氧呼吸，兩者是同時進行的。
Option A is incorrect; even under oxygen debt, muscle cells will use up all available oxygen to continue aerobic respiration; both processes occur simultaneously.
選項 B 錯誤，肌肉細胞不能將乳酸氧化，乳酸必須經血液運往肝臟才能被氧化或轉化。
Option B is incorrect; muscle cells cannot oxidize lactic acid; it must be transported via blood to the liver to be oxidized or converted.
選項 D 錯誤，缺氧呼吸（每分子葡萄糖產 2 ATP）釋放的能量遠少於需氧呼吸（38 ATP）。
Option D is incorrect; the energy released by anaerobic respiration (2 ATP per glucose molecule) is much less than that of aerobic respiration (38 ATP).

📌 考試提醒
劇烈運動時，需氧呼吸與缺氧呼吸在肌肉內同時並行，後者起著「應急補充能量」的作用。
During vigorous exercise, aerobic and anaerobic respiration run concurrently in muscles, with the latter serving the role of "emergency energy supplementation".
常見錯誤：學生常誤以為當細胞進入「缺氧狀態」時，需氧呼吸會完全停止並切換至全缺氧呼吸。

📌 參考答案

A. The fish eaten by the penguins contain insecticides.

📌 詳細解釋
農業地區使用的殺蟲劑可能漏入海洋，並被微小的生物吸收。
The insecticides used in the farming areas may leach into the ocean and be absorbed by small organisms.

These insecticides are passed from the small organisms to the fish and from the fish to the penguins through the food web, causing bioaccumulation.

選項 C 錯誤，大部分殺蟲劑不溶於水，且會在企鵝飲用前被海水大量稀釋。
Option C is incorrect because most insecticides are water-insoluble and would be diluted by seawater before penguins drink it.

脂溶性且不易被分解的化學物質會沿著食物鏈在生物體內不斷積聚，這過程稱為生物累積。
Fat-soluble and non-biodegradable chemicals accumulate in organisms along the food chain, a process known as bioaccumulation.
常見錯誤：學生常忽略海洋環流和食物網的連結，誤以為極地生物完全不受人類農業活動影響。
Common trap: Students often ignore the connection of ocean currents and food webs, mistakenly thinking polar organisms are completely unaffected by human agricultural activities.

📌 參考答案
B. 形式：糖，運輸途徑：韌皮部
B. Form: Sugar, Transport pathway: Phloem

📌 詳細解釋
植物葉片進行光合作用所產生的碳水化合物，會轉化為可溶於水的形式（如蔗糖）以便運輸。
Carbohydrates produced by photosynthesis in leaves are converted into a soluble form (such as sucrose) for transport.
這些糖分會透過活的韌皮部組織運送到植物的其他部位。
These sugars are transported via the living phloem to other parts of the plant.
選項 C 及 D 錯誤，澱粉不溶於水，因此無法在植物體內被直接運輸。
Options C and D are incorrect; starch is insoluble in water and therefore cannot be transported within the plant directly.
選項 A 錯誤，木質部主要負責運輸水分及無機礦物質，而非有機養分。
Option A is incorrect; the xylem is primarily responsible for transporting water and inorganic minerals, not organic nutrients.

📌 考試提醒
植物體內有機物質的運輸形式必為可溶性的糖，而儲藏形式則通常為不溶性的澱粉。
The transport form of organic substances in plants must be soluble sugars, while the storage form is usually insoluble starch.
常見錯誤：學生極易將光合作用的最終儲藏產物（澱粉）與植物體內實際的運輸形式（糖）混淆。
Common trap: Students very easily confuse the final storage product of photosynthesis (starch) with the actual transport form (sugar) within the plant.

📌 參考答案
D. 這植物的二氧化碳供應不足
D. The carbon dioxide supply to the plant is insufficient

📌 詳細解釋
泥土中若缺乏硝酸鹽或鎂，會阻礙葉綠素的合成，導致植物葉片變黃。
A lack of nitrates or magnesium in the soil hinders chlorophyll synthesis, causing plant leaves to turn yellow.
光線供應不足同樣會阻礙葉綠素形成，這現象被稱為黃化現象。
Without light, no chlorophyll can be formed, a phenomenon of yellowing leaves known as etiolation.
相反，缺乏二氧化碳只會減慢光合作用速率，但絕不會直接導致葉片變黃。
Conversely, a lack of carbon dioxide will only slow down the photosynthetic rate, but will never directly cause the yellowing of leaves.

📌 考試提醒
鎂和硝酸鹽是合成葉綠素的必需礦物質，而光線是合成葉綠素的必需條件，缺乏其中一項皆會引起黃葉。
Magnesium and nitrates are essential minerals for chlorophyll synthesis, and light is an essential condition for it; lacking any of these causes yellow leaves.
常見錯誤：學生常誤以為所有光合作用原料（如二氧化碳）的缺乏都會破壞葉綠體結構並導致葉片變黃。
Common trap: Students often mistakenly assume that a deficiency of any raw material for photosynthesis (like carbon dioxide) will destroy chloroplast structures and cause leaves to turn yellow.

📌 參考答案
D. 血液：有紅血細胞，淋巴：沒有紅血細胞
D. Blood: Has red blood cells, Lymph: Does not have red blood cells

📌 詳細解釋
血液含有紅血細胞，但組織液由血液形成時不含紅血細胞，因此成分與之相似的淋巴亦沒有紅血細胞。
Blood contains red blood cells, but the intercellular fluid derived from blood lacks them, so the lymph which has a similar composition also does not have red blood cells.
選項 A 及 B 錯誤，血液和淋巴液皆含有脂肪和葡萄糖等養分。
Options A and B are incorrect; both blood and lymph contain nutrients like fats and glucose.
選項 C 錯誤，吞噬細胞能擠出微血管進入組織液，因此兩者皆含有吞噬細胞。
Option C is incorrect; phagocytes can squeeze out of capillaries into tissue fluid, so both contain phagocytes.

📌 考試提醒
淋巴的成分與組織液相似，含有白血細胞及脂質，但不含紅血細胞及血漿蛋白。
The composition of lymph is similar to tissue fluid, containing white blood cells and lipids, but lacking red blood cells and plasma proteins.
常見錯誤：學生常誤以為淋巴系統完全不含任何血細胞，忘記了淋巴細胞和吞噬細胞會進入淋巴系統。
Common trap: Students often mistakenly think the lymphatic system completely lacks any blood cells, forgetting that lymphocytes and phagocytes enter the lymphatic system.

📌 參考答案
C. 3 個單位
C. 3 units

📌 詳細解釋
當光強度為 6 個單位時，圖表顯示植物對二氧化碳的淨吸收速率為 2 個單位。
When the light intensity is 6 units, the graph shows that the net carbon dioxide uptake rate is 2 units.
當光強度為 0 時，二氧化碳的淨釋出速率為 1 個單位，代表呼吸作用速率在任何時候均維持在 1 個單位。
When the light intensity is 0, the net carbon dioxide release rate is 1 unit, implying that the respiration rate always remains at 1 unit.
植物實際的光合作用速率，等於淨吸收量加上呼吸作用釋放的量，即 2 + 1 = 3 個單位。
The actual rate of photosynthesis equals the net uptake amount plus the amount released by respiration, i.e., 2 + 1 = 3 units.

📌 考試提醒
實際光合作用速率（總產量）等於淨光合作用速率（表觀吸收量）加上呼吸作用速率。
Actual photosynthetic rate (gross production) equals net photosynthetic rate (apparent uptake) plus respiration rate.
常見錯誤：學生常直接讀取圖表上的淨吸收速率（2個單位）作為答案，完全忽略了同時正在進行的呼吸作用。
Common trap: Students often directly read the net uptake rate (2 units) from the graph as the answer, completely ignoring the simultaneously occurring respiration.

📌 參考答案
C. 該植物的光合作用速率與呼吸作用速率相等。
C. The rate of photosynthesis of the plant is equal to the rate of respiration.

📌 詳細解釋
當光強度是 1 個單位時，二氧化碳的淨吸收速率為零，這個點被稱為補償點。
When the light intensity is 1 unit, the net carbon dioxide uptake rate is zero, and this point is known as the compensation point.
此時光合作用吸收的二氧化碳量剛好等於呼吸作用釋出的二氧化碳量，兩者互相抵消。
At this point, the amount of carbon dioxide absorbed by photosynthesis exactly equals the amount released by respiration, cancelling each other out.
選項 B 錯誤，氣孔並未關閉，氣體交換仍在進行，只是淨交換量為零。
Option B is incorrect; stomata are not closed and gaseous exchange is still occurring, just with a net exchange of zero.

📌 考試提醒
在補償點時，植物的光合作用與呼吸作用速率相等，氣體淨交換量為零，植物沒有有機物質的淨增長。
At the compensation point, the rates of photosynthesis and respiration are equal, net gaseous exchange is zero, and there is no net growth of organic matter.
常見錯誤：學生常誤以為氣體淨吸收量為零即代表植物的光合作用完全停止。
Common trap: Students often mistakenly assume that a zero net gas uptake implies photosynthesis has completely stopped.

📌 參考答案
D. q - p
D. q - p

📌 詳細解釋
量筒內水平面的變化 q 代表植物根部總共吸收的水分體積（數值上等同於質量）。
The change in the water level in the measuring cylinder q represents the total volume of water absorbed by the roots (numerically equivalent to its mass).
電子秤讀數的減少量 p 代表植物因葉片蒸發而流失的水分總質量。
The decrease in the electronic balance reading p represents the total mass of water lost due to evaporation from the leaves.
植物體內最終保留的水量，必然等於吸收的總水量減去流失的總水量，因此為 q - p。
The final amount of water retained by the plant must equal the total amount absorbed minus the total amount lost, hence q - p.

📌 考試提醒
植物吸收的水分絕大部分會經蒸騰作用流失，只有極少部分會被保留用於維持細胞膨脹及光合作用。
The vast majority of water absorbed by a plant is lost through transpiration, with only a tiny fraction retained to maintain cell turgidity and for photosynthesis.
常見錯誤：學生常混淆 p 和 q 的含義，誤用流失量減去吸收量。
Common trap: Students often confuse the meanings of p and q, mistakenly subtracting the absorbed amount from the lost amount.

📌 參考答案
A. 光亮和大風的環境
A. Bright and windy environment

📌 詳細解釋
數值 p 反映了植物因蒸發而流失的水量，數值最高代表蒸騰速率最快。
The value p reflects the amount of water lost due to evaporation; the highest value represents the fastest transpiration rate.
在光亮的環境下，氣孔會張開以進行光合作用，增加水分的消耗和散失。
Under light conditions, stomata will open widely to facilitate photosynthesis, increasing water consumption and loss.
大風的環境會吹走氣孔附近積聚的水蒸氣，增大水蒸氣濃度梯度，從而加快蒸騰作用的速率。
A windy environment removes the water vapour accumulated around the stomata, increasing the concentration gradient and thus speeding up the rate of transpiration.

📌 考試提醒
高溫、強光、大風和低相對濕度是加快蒸騰作用速率的四大環境因素。
High temperature, strong light, high wind speed, and low relative humidity are the four main environmental factors that speed up transpiration.
常見錯誤：學生有時會錯誤解讀 p 的意思，以為是在問如何保留最多水分，從而選了相反的答案。
Common trap: Students sometimes misinterpret the meaning of p, thinking it asks how to retain the most water, thereby choosing the opposite answer.

📌 參考答案
A. 沒有受精作用。
A. There is no fertilization.

📌 詳細解釋
無性繁殖在生物學上的核心定義，是繁殖過程中不涉及配子的結合或受精作用。
The core biological definition of asexual reproduction is that the reproduction process does not involve the fusion of gametes or fertilization.
塊莖、根莖、鱗莖等植物器官直接發育出新個體，沒有配子融合，因此屬於無性繁殖。
Vegetative organs like tubers, rhizomes, and bulbs develop directly into new individuals without gamete fusion, so they belong to asexual reproduction.
選項 B、C 和 D 描述的特徵可能與無性繁殖相關，但不是分類為無性繁殖的根本原因。
Options B, C, and D describe features that may be related to asexual reproduction, but they are not the fundamental reasons for this classification.

📌 考試提醒
無性生殖必定不涉及配子形成與受精，其後代的基因組合與親本完全相同。
Asexual reproduction must not involve gamete formation and fertilization, and the genetic makeup of the offspring is identical to the parent.
常見錯誤：學生常以為「只涉及一個親本」是無性生殖的唯一絕對標準，而忽略了有性生殖中的自花傳粉。
Common trap: Students often assume "involving only one parent" is the sole absolute criterion for asexual reproduction, ignoring self-pollination in sexual reproduction.

📌 參考答案
C. 前者由血液帶往目標器官。
C. The former are carried by blood to target organs.

📌 詳細解釋
激素是由內分泌腺分泌的化學信使，必定依賴血液循環系統運送至目標器官。
Hormones are chemical messengers secreted by endocrine glands and must rely on the blood circulatory system to be transported to target organs.

In contrast, some enzymes (such as digestive enzymes) are secreted by exocrine glands and are not carried by blood.

選項 B 錯誤，激素及部分酶皆可由腺體產生。
Option B is incorrect; both hormones and some enzymes can be produced by a gland.

📌 考試提醒
內分泌系統（激素）無導管並依靠血液運輸；外分泌系統（如消化液）有導管且不入血。
The endocrine system (hormones) is ductless and relies on blood transport; the exocrine system (like digestive juices) has ducts and does not enter the blood.
常見錯誤：學生常忘記消化液是由外分泌腺產生，並錯誤以為所有酶都只侷限在細胞內運作。
Common trap: Students often forget that digestive juices are produced by exocrine glands and mistakenly think all enzymes are confined to operating strictly within cells.

📌 參考答案
A. [平行光線聚焦於視網膜前]
A. [Parallel rays focus in front of the retina]

近視患者由於眼球過長或晶狀體過厚，導致其對遠處光線的折射能力過強。
Because the eyeball is too long or the lens is too thick, short-sighted patients have an excessively strong refractive power for distant light.
因此，來自遠處物體的平行光線在到達視網膜之前便已經聚焦，形成模糊影像。
Therefore, parallel rays from distant objects are focused in front of the retina, forming a blurred image.
選項 B 及 D 的光線圖顯示光線呈發散狀，代表正在觀察近物，不適用於表示近視的缺陷。
Options B and D show diverging rays representing viewing near objects, which are not suitable for showing the defect of myopia.

近視是因為無法對焦遠物（平行光線聚焦於網膜前），需要凹透鏡矯正。
Myopia is the inability to focus on distant objects (parallel rays focus in front of the retina) requiring concave lenses.
常見錯誤：學生極易混淆代表遠物的「平行光線」和代表近物的「發散光線」。
Common trap: Students very easily confuse "parallel rays" representing distant objects with "diverging rays" representing near objects.

📌 參考答案
C. 生物生存年代的資料。
C. Information about the era in which the organisms lived.

📌 詳細解釋
科學家可以透過分析化石周圍的泥土或岩石地層，來測定該生物存活的歷史年代。
Scientists can date the soil or rocks surrounding the fossils to obtain their duration of existence.
將不同年代的化石按時間次序排列，就可獲得物種演化的關係。
Arranging fossils from different eras in chronological sequence allows one to obtain evolutionary relationships.

📌 考試提醒
化石紀錄是支持演化論最直接的證據，它透過地層年代展現了生物由簡單到複雜的演化趨勢。
Fossil records are the most direct evidence supporting the theory of evolution, demonstrating the evolutionary trend from simple to complex organisms through stratum dating.
常見錯誤：學生常過分誇大化石的作用，誤以為它能解釋突變原因或展現完整的族群動態。
Common trap: Students often exaggerate the role of fossils, mistakenly thinking they can explain the causes of mutations or reveal complete population dynamics.

📌 參考答案
B. 整棵幼苗：X，子葉：Z
B. Whole seedling: X, Cotyledon: Z

種子萌發初期只能依賴子葉貯存的食物進行呼吸作用，所以整棵幼苗（曲線 X）和子葉（曲線 Z）的乾質量會先下降。

當幼苗長出葉子並開始進行光合作用後，整棵幼苗（曲線 X）的乾質量便開始回升。
After the leaves grow and carry out photosynthesis to produce food, the dry mass of the whole seedling (Curve X) begins to rise.
胚芽持續發育長大，其乾質量會不斷上升（曲線 Y）；而子葉的養分因被耗盡而持續下跌（曲線 Z）。

The change in dry mass of a plant reflects the net change in organic matter, which is the result of the tug-of-war between photosynthesis and respiration.
常見錯誤：學生常未能將整棵幼苗乾質量先跌後升的轉捩點，與幼苗開始進行光合作用的時間點作準確連結。
Common trap: Students often fail to accurately link the turning point where the whole seedling's dry mass stops falling and starts rising with the time point when the seedling begins photosynthesis.

📌 參考答案
D. 第 7 至第 10 日
